author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning
title: Sonnets from the Portuguese
edition: Caradoc Press, Bedford Park, Chiswick, London, 1906, transcribed by David Price. Original English poems, not a translation. Common three-space display margin removed; CRLF becomes LF; original punctuation, words and 14-line sonnet boundaries retained. The library holds all forty-four sonnets under their numerals; the cover and decorative-graphic placeholders, title page and index of first lines are omitted.

rights.basis: The original English text is in this 1906 publication/transcription of the dated collection, published before 1931 and in the US public domain by 2026. Project Gutenberg catalogue explicitly labels this text Public domain in the USA.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg plain text (pglaf mirror of ebook 2002), CRLF line ends normalised to LF. Removed the Gutenberg header, footer and licence and everything before Sonnet I (picture placeholders, title page, index of first lines); each sonnet numeral became a level-2 heading and each sonnet one stanza, with the file’s three-space display margin removed from every line.
